verdict.rationale: The product documents single-command installs: `npx skills@latest add mattpocock/skills` and `claude plugin install mattpocock-skills@claude-plugins-official` via Claude Code's official marketplace, plus marketplace routes for Codex and Copilot. A real runtime probe confirmed the npx path installs non-interactively into ./.claude/skills/, and the docs say you then just type a slash command. Missing for 10: hands-on confirmation that the installed skills are actually picked up in a fresh agent session (the probe verified only the files on disk), and the Codex/Copilot routes take two commands rather than one.
